mutations.name: a member with a verdict is dispatched again
kills: reviewHead spends one session per member when correctness and the adversary each say MERGE once (tp#2145)

mutations.name: the same refusal twice spends the rest of its row
mutations.find: last !== undefined && next.text !== undefined && last.class === next.class && last.text === next.text;
kills: reviewHead sends a member that repeats the same refusal after its correction to the fixer, with no fresh member

mutations.name: a member whose session never started is not retried
kills: reviewHead retries a member whose session never started once, under a fresh name

mutations.name: a run recorded before preflight runs preflight on replay
kills: reviewHead skips preflight on a run recorded before it existed and dispatches the plan its intent recorded
